text:
Predicates:
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastOlympicGames(x) ::: x is the last Olympic games.
HeldIn(x, y) ::: x was held in y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in y.
Premises:
SportingEvent(olympicGames) ∧ LastOlympicGames(olympicGames) ∧ HeldIn(olympicGames, tokyo) ::: The Olympic games is a sporting event. The last Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(unitedStates, tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
SportingEvent(worldChampionships) ::: The world championships is a sporting event.
